snippet.title: I SHALL NAME THE DEAD | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Nameless Dead cannot be buried, their remains pile up in a mass of indignity. You have crawled from the gutter to name them. Explore the cemetery and uncover their names before the Worm eats your insides.

STEAM LINK: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4881350/I_SHALL_NAME_THE_DEAD/?curator_clanid=4777282

---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards
